Bihar vidhanasbha chunav men bijepi aur jediyu ke gathbandhan vale endie ko bari jit mili hai. in natijon ke bad pradhanmantri modi ne apne bhashan men mahilaon aur yuvaon ka khas zikr kiya. aise men bihar ke yuva in natijon par kya bol rahe hain, dekhie yah vidiyo.
Vidiyoh abhinav goyal aur dipak jasrotiya
